findings.title: Existing reader helper is named incorrectly
findings.why_it_matters: An executor following the named reuse point would look for a helper that does not exist.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the incorrect helper name with the existing classification-enrichment helper.

findings.title: Published headline cleanup would break permanent links
findings.section: U4 - Permanent Post and OriginalContent detail pages
findings.why_it_matters: A shared headline URL can return not found after retention deletes its published content, localized text and source relations.
evidence: Every displayed Post or published OriginalContent unit has a durable first-party URL independent of feed position, category, title and current hero selection.
A trend/headline item with no existing story identity uses /content/<content_id>/ for its immutable content row, after proving it was published; no new content storage or synthetic UUID is needed.
findings.suggested_fix: Make preservation of all previously published content and citations a G2-owned prerequisite to the OriginalContent part of U4, verify historical publication with the workflow-specific evidence, and test old links after the real prune path runs.

findings.title: Navigation unnecessarily waits for the entire G2 integration
findings.section: U5/U6 - General shell and live-card integration
findings.why_it_matters: The written dependencies make otherwise independent lower panels wait for G2 OriginalContent, contradicting the agreed sequencing.
evidence: These four feeds do not need G2's new headline/Chatter/Pulse writing pipeline.
Dependencies: U1; U4 supplies item-page shell reuse.
findings.suggested_fix: Make U5/U6 depend on the Post portion of U4 only; preserve full OriginalContent integration as a completion requirement for U7.

findings.title: Continuation can reorder items when the clock advances
findings.section: KTD3 - Bounded ordering at the reader
findings.why_it_matters: An event can move from upcoming to live between pages, moving across the continuation boundary and producing missing or repeated cards.
evidence: Use one response as_of, stable post-ID tie-breaks and signed cursors bound to section/filter/locale/order.
findings.suggested_fix: Carry the first-page as_of and fetched-at cutoff in continuation, restart on refresh, and test a start/end boundary between pages.
